relationships.subject: BoNT/E
relationships.evidence_quote: Consistent with the behavioral findings, analysis of NLRP3 expression in the iTG on POD 5 revealed that treatment with 10 U/kg BoNT/E significantly reduced NLRP3 expression compared with the vehicle-treated group

relationships.subject: BoNT/E
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with 10 U/kg BoNT/E significantly reduced the IAN injury-induced increase in HIF-1α expression in the iTG

relationships.subject: PX-478
relationships.evidence_quote: In addition, intraganglionic injection of 1 µg PX-478 significantly reduced NLRP3 expression in the iTG

relationships.subject: HIF-1alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, these findings demonstrate that modulation of the HIF-1α-NLRP3 pathway in the iTG plays a critical regulatory role in neuropathic pain development

relationships.subject: BoNT/E
relationships.evidence_quote: Administration of 10 U/kg BoNT/E significantly attenuated the elevated levels of IAN injury-induced IL-1β, IL-18, TNF-α, and IL-6

key_findings: IAN injury raised HIF-1alpha, NLRP3 and cytokines in the trigeminal ganglion; BoNT/E reduced them and relieved allodynia.
HIF-1alpha inhibitor PX-478 mimicked BoNT/E, lowering NLRP3 and cytokines.
